name: Beat Dancer 3D
author: Cyberdelia
help: A 3D robot dances while disco tiles and moving lights follow the beat of your music. It starts a silent demo tempo when no beat is found. Wheel turns the view. Prev and Next change the style. Play toggles camera orbit. Select starts a four-beat spin. Menu pauses and offers music sync, tempo, style and performance options. Your music is never changed.
